spans.s: paiśunika, adj. (= Pali pesunika, not ˚ṇika with PTSD; to piśuna plus -ika), slanderous: after mṛṣāvādika or ˚vādin, Divy 〔301.23〕; Gv 〔159.14〕; 〔352.18〕 (all prose). Cf. next.
paiśunya, adj. (Skt. id. and Pali pesuniya, ˚ṇiya, pesuñña, only as nt. abstr.), = prec.: mṛṣāvādinām ˚nyānāṃ Gv 〔228.14〕 (prose).
